violation_type.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Proof of Notification about Deficencies in Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation as specified (26 TAC §746.801(22))
violation_type.short_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Proof of Notification about Deficencies in Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation as specified
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not notify parents of a finding of abuse, neglect or exploitation using form 7266 with 5 days of notification from Licensing as required.
